target.name: ByteCodeInterpreter value-stack arithmetic (primary slots 8 and 9)
target.role: the rest of the value-stack arithmetic family: slot 8 subtracts the top from the deeper value, slot 9 multiplies them
target.notes: primary dispatch slots 8 (0x08003D52) and 9 (0x08003D66), 20 bytes and 10 instructions each, mutually adjacent and adjacent to slot 7 which is lifted separately so its report stays reproducible. Both are leaves: no calls and no literal pool. The three tile 0x08003D3E..0x08003D7A and differ in exactly one instruction - `adds r1, r2, r1`, `subs r1, r2, r1`, `muls r2, r1, r2`. Slot 8 is the member that proves the operand order for the whole family, because addition and multiplication are commutative: `subs r1, r2, r1` computes r2 - r1, r2 holds the lower slot and r1 the top, so the shared contract is `deeper = FIRST source, top = SECOND source`. Note slot 9's combining instruction writes r2 rather than r1, so its store is `str r2,[r0]` where the others store r1; the result register differs but the slot written and the contract do not. All three are plain 32-bit operations with no saturation and no overflow branch, so `muls` keeps only the low half of a 64-bit product. There is NO underflow check in any member: a zero counter becomes 0xFFFFFFFF and the arithmetic runs against the word immediately below the context object - slot 8 INCREMENTS it (deeper - 0xFFFFFFFF = deeper + 1) and slot 9 replaces it with its own negation (0xFFFFFFFF * deeper = -deeper) - while no value slot is touched, and successive underflows walk four bytes further down. Reproduced exactly, with no guard added. No opcode table is reconstructed and no opcode index is given a name beyond the operation its own instruction performs.

verdicts_are_independent: SEMANTIC, MODERN_BUILD and ADS_MATCH answer different questions and none is evidence for another. A passing modern build says nothing about the original compiler; a passing semantic run only removes one class of error.

literal_pools.interpretation: the original's literals are accounted for by the words the unit declares; the modern build pools differently, which is a structural consequence of the compiler rather than a defect in the reconstruction. It is also why a function with a literal load cannot be compared standalone.

comparison.match_claim_note: MEASUREMENT ONLY. This compares a modern GCC build against the cartridge. A modern compiler is not the original compiler, so a difference here is expected and proves nothing; an identity here would also prove nothing about ADS 1.2. ADS_MATCH stays BLOCKED.
